name: Manifest V2 Test PAM Provider
description: A Keyfactor PAM Provider plugin supporting credential retrieval from Manifest V2 Test.

Parameters.Name: ManifestV2TestUrl
Parameters.Description: The URL of the ManifestV2Test server (e.g., https://manifestV2Test.example.com)

Parameters.Name: Login
Parameters.Description: The login that will access the ManifestV2Test account and variable within the account. The login must have a policy with “read” and “execute” permissions on the target variable

Parameters.Name: ApiKey
Parameters.Description: The API key or password for the login

Parameters.Name: VariablePath
Parameters.Description: The full path to the variable (secret) in ManifestV2Test (e.g., 'my-app/db-password' or 'production/api-keys/service-token')
